title: [AUG-79] Live transcription: clean all
why_we_need_this:
I need a button Clean All alongside the existing buttons: 
Pause Copy All (first row)
Stop Clear All (second row)

Colours: 
Pause - yellow frame, yellow filled on target
Copy All - green frame, green filled on target
Stop - red filled
Clear All - red frame, red filled on target

both Stop and Clear All should have a confirmation dialogue window: "are you sure?"
Buttons there: 
Yes, proceed - red frame, red filled on target
No, return - green frame, green filled on target
